Generation17 Young Leader Rahaf Abu Mayyaleh is on a mission to close the digital skills gap in Jordan—a country struggling with youth unemployment. She co-founded the organization IBTKRGO with a bold vision: what if learning coding, robotics, and AI could be accessible, sustainable, and fun? Her eco-friendly education kits use recyclable materials and electronic components that can be upcycled into art and toys. With IBTKRGO, kids and teens aren't just discovering technology for the first time, they're learning how it can create solutions for people and the planet.

Generation17 is an initiative in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) that aims to harness technology to elevate the voices of young leaders around the globe who are working to achieve the Global Goals.
